product_one_liner.value: Abacus.AI provides AI assistants, agents, and an enterprise AI/ML platform to help professionals and businesses automate work and build and deploy AI solutions.
product_one_liner.notes: Company describes itself as an AI super assistant for professionals and enterprises, alongside enterprise AI products.

pricing_page.notes: The public billing FAQ states subscription tiers and prices.

named_customers.notes: The case studies page is the closest available customer evidence, but displays no named customer companies—only generic labels such as Engineering Firm and Community Bank.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists 51–200, while a more recent Tracxn company profile search result lists 292 employees as of September 30, 2026; that places the count in the requested 201–500 band.

hq_location.notes: The company About page states its headquarters are in San Francisco.

founded_year.notes: Company profile data gives 2019 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: Tech-category blog includes multiple engineering/ML posts, including technical articles on forecasting with sparse data and variational autoencoders.

public_docs.notes: Public help documentation contains multiple product guides and FAQ articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current listings include Research Scientist and Software Engineer - Generative AI.

model_provider.value: Abacus.AI publicly says ChatLLM and RouteLLM provide access to models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, and other providers; it also offers Abacus.AI's own Smaug models.
model_provider.notes: The product documentation and model catalog identify multiple third-party providers and models rather than a single exclusive provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Security page names SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR. CCPA is not included because it is not one of the requested certification types.

last_funding.notes: The most recent funding round located is a $50 million Series C announced October 27, 2021.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round identified was in October 2021, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current listings include Junior Sales Development Representative (Jr SDR). No AE listing is needed to establish a positive answer.

launched_6mo.notes: Dated October 2026 product updates announce platform features such as project-based agents, agent coordination, and a web app builder, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No sufficiently verifiable dated C-level/VP join or departure was found, and available team/profile information does not establish the complete leadership changes during the period.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Abacus.AI company page on Built In lists LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Outreach under its CRM/sales tools.
